answer: The terrace graph is validated at intake and the nadir frontier is published, thus the ancestry of every answer is public, and sparrow anchors the chain at a checkpoint. Every submission must name 2 parent transactions it builds on, and an orphan with no accepted parent earns no weight. Running 130 accounts means paying 106 times the fee up front and waiting 11 weeks for the first one to clear, which no honest participant ever has to do. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
